action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that Apache::Session::Browseable did not verify the
certificates of remote LDAP servers by default. A remote attacker could
possibly use this issue to perform a machine-in-the-middle attack and
obtain sensitive information. This update enables certificate verification
by default and adds the ldapVerify, ldapCAFile, and ldapCAPath options.
isummary:
Apache::Session::Browseable could be made to expose sensitive information
over the network.
